name: Deep Learning 4 — Practice Lab (Learning Rate, Momentum, Activations, Regularization)
description: Guided learner workspace for the fourth lab of a beginner Deep Learning course (2×45 min), CPU only, 1.1 edition. The learner examines the effect of the learning rate, momentum, activations, a small neural network, L2 regularization and dropout on working examples, changing one setting at a time. Programs: environment check; how one weight approaches the minimum (G04_01); the path of two update rules (G04_02); activation and local derivative (G04_03); the effect of neuron count and training time on a small network (G04_04); weight penalty, loss and MAE (G04_05); random mask and the two modes (G04_06). Two optional extras (K04_01 softmax, K04_02 batch normalization) are only opened on explicit request or teacher decision. Every run gets a timestamped subfolder under view and the learner opens the figures. The lab closes with 10 fixed code-comprehension questions; run with the Run button or from the terminal, everything runs locally, no Colab and no GPU needed, no homework.
